articles.summary: Dr. Ascheim has over 30 years of clinical and executive experience advancing breakthrough therapies, including gene, cell, and biologics MIAMI, July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Longeveron Inc. (NASDAQ: LGVN) a clinical stage biotechnology company developing cellular therapy for life-threatening, rare pediatric and chronic aging-related conditions, today announced that Deborah D. Ascheim, M.D., has been elected to the Longeveron Board of Directors. Dr. Ascheim is a strategic biotech Chief Medical Officer and physician who has over 30 years of clinical and executive experience advancing breakthrough therapies, including gene, cell, and biologics, for rare, ultra-rare, and common diseases across multiple indications. “I am delighted to welcome Deborah, with her impressive development track record with gene, cell and biologics, to the Board of Directors,” said Dr. Joshua M.
